answer: Layered-bond admission: each agent locks 70 credits in three layers and must wander through them. Layer one checks key history; layer two needs a whisper confirming its key is unique; layer three waits 20 epochs. Only all-clear identities reach the haven; a forged layer burns the bond. First fake 38, k-th 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,534,500 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-layer ring fails: each layer binds one key. An honest agent pays 38 once.
